title: Train neural networks
description: Train a CPU image classifier, preserve its complete state through interruption, inspect held-out errors and verify its exported inference. Language modeling and TPU work are optional branches.
outcome: A recoverable image classifier with verified exported inference

capstone.title: A recoverable image classifier with verified exported inference
capstone.assessment: Complete the eight image lifecycle stages and changed-condition synthesis: independent CNN checks, full-state recovery, frozen error analysis, precision, export and measured inference. Transformer-specific evidence belongs to the complementary text harness.
evidence: Training and evaluation splits, seeded configuration and learning curves
A saved full state whose next update matches an uninterrupted run
Predictions from the restored model and examples explaining its failures

audience: Learners who can trace shapes, differentiate a scalar loss and carry state through an update.
firstArtifact: A CPU classifier with stable loss, replay checks and count-weighted evaluation.
studyAdvice: Build the classifier first, freeze its evaluation split and add optimizer, random and data-position state before rehearsing interruption. Continue through CPU performance and deployment to the image harness. Use the reproducible-experiments workshop to compare changes. The optional language branch starts at Transformers after recovery; add pretraining and supervised adaptation next. Complete the RL phase before learned-reward PPO. These branches are separate from the classifier evidence.

additionalGuides.title: Reproducible JAX/Flax experiments workshop
additionalGuides.scope: CPU-tested experiments, logging, paired comparisons and a Markdown research notebook. Optional trackers run locally; accelerator qualification is separate.

additionalGuides.title: Optional TPU and Google Cloud specialization
additionalGuides.scope: The required path runs on CPU. This optional route adds cloud provisioning, TPU execution and hardware-specific evidence; CPU examples do not qualify TPU performance.

additionalGuides.title: Optional language-model branch
additionalGuides.scope: After recovery: Transformers → self-supervised pretraining → supervised adaptation. The learned-reward PPO lesson additionally requires the four RL lessons. Keep text-harness evidence separate from the image capstone.

additionalGuides.title: Optional staged embedding-model pilot
additionalGuides.scope: A 70,765-parameter CPU encoder carries checkpoints from MLM through contrastive continuation and query-positive adaptation to held-out retrieval and fresh-process export. Its measured poor result is retained. Follow its language and recovery prerequisites; this is separate from the image capstone and from planned 300M training.
